name: skylight-redhead-butterfly-tattoo
image_purpose: fashion lookbook and beauty editorial image

prompt.project_info: Create a full-body fashion editorial in a softly lit indoor garden beneath a skylight.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, long natural red waves, light eyes, fair warm-toned skin, and a calm confident expression. She wears a smoky-lavender asymmetrical dress with a side opening, minimal open-toe heels, and a fine-line minimalist butterfly tattoo cluster at the upper hip transitioning slightly toward the upper thigh.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical editorial shot, relaxed upright posture with hands loosely intertwined, green plants surrounding the subject, white stone floor, skylight overhead, tattoo and face in balanced focus.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural soft diffused skylight creates gentle highlights on red hair, dress, skin, and tattoo; quiet botanical atmosphere with realistic daylight.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, f/2.8, ISO 200, 1/200s visual treatment, vertical composition, photorealistic textile and tattoo detail, natural anatomy, no logos or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Full-body vertical fashion editorial of an adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, long natural red waves, light eyes, fair warm-toned skin, calm confident expression, wearing a smoky-lavender asymmetrical dress with a side opening, minimal open-toe heels, and a fine-line minimalist butterfly tattoo cluster at the upper hip transitioning slightly toward the upper thigh. Relaxed upright posture with hands loosely intertwined, soft-lit indoor garden room, lush green plants, white stone floor, overhead skylight, natural soft diffused light, gentle highlights on hair and tattoo, 35mm lens, f/2.8, ISO 200, 1/200s, photorealistic botanical fashion editorial.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, youthful or underage appearance, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, malformed tattoo, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, signature
